_note: Lifecycle carbon footprint per garment, kg CO2e, cradle to grave. A category gets a number only with a cited source (CONTRACT rule: no number without a source). Categories not listed are counted as skipped but add nothing to the CO2e estimate. Every figure is an industry average, so the UI labels the total as an estimate.

jeans.source: Levi's 501 lifecycle assessment (2015), as cited by the UN Convention to Combat Desertification

tee.source: Carbonfact, Carbon footprint of a t-shirt (median)

dress.source: Carbonfact, Carbon footprint of a dress (median)
